P1 — Counterevidence: The learned network may still perform well; a smooth or nonsmooth proximal scheme can define a different valid method. Even granting Eq12 as an independently chosen surrogate, its derivative coefficient is C^2+mu+alpha*Ls*w^2, so the omitted alpha cannot be absorbed only in the denominator while retained in the numerator. Eq17 background scalar minimizer independently passes.

P2 — Counterevidence: Auxiliary coarse-mask supervision still trains shared encoder and other persistent branches. Reconstructed branch execution can affect runtime/state but is not a gradient route to the optimized segmentation loss. Local modules can propagate gradients to inputs even though their fresh parameters are absent from optimizer/model checkpoints. A different historical program remains possible.

P3 — Counterevidence: Many other metrics remain favorable, including COD10K F and CORN sensitivity. Separate inaccessible attachments may contain more experiments; this acceptance did not obtain them.
The original report's complete scope, counterevidence and unresolved questions are retained below.
